Chat request with response_format json_schema that validates the output structure

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, ResponseFormat, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "What is the temperature in Paris today?" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4", responseFormat: { jsonSchema: { name: "weather", schema: { properties: { temp: { type: "number" } }, required: ["temp"], type: "object" } }, type: "json_schema" } as ResponseFormat });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
```
